title: Cleanliness and Prevention: Early Healthy Habits
summary: This age is ideal for instilling habits that will protect your child for life: washing hands before eating and after using the toilet, brushing teeth twice daily, and the etiquette of sneezing. Make them an enjoyable routine, not a command, and be a practical role model; the child imitates what they see, not what they are told.
try_this: This week: Make handwashing and brushing teeth a consistent and fun routine (a short song or a counter).
reflection_prompts: Which healthy habit does your child master?
